title: Ecclesiastical History
author: sozomen
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: A church history from 323 to 425, parallel to Socrates and drawing on similar documentary material, with its own emphasis on monasticism and on the eastern provinces.
historicalContext: Written in Constantinople by a lawyer from Bethelia in Palestine, and dedicated to the emperor Theodosius II.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the CCEL volume page at read time. Zenos's translation from the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, second series, volume 2, served by the CCEL.
